title: request_security_review input
description: Asks for the security review of an agent or an application. The engine creates a Review (O21) of type security-review, status due; it reaches the security reviewer whom the go-live gate asks. A request, never a decision: the review ends in a decision that people accept. If an open security review already exists for the application, the tool returns it and writes nothing new.
$comment: WORKING DEFAULT (open design question 9), as for request_architecture_review: an AI client may send the request where the Tool Policy row says AI May Submit = yes for subject kind review-request. Shipped yes.

businessApplicationId.description: The agent or application to review.

changeRequestId.description: The change to review, if the review is about one change.

reason.description: What the reviewer should look at, and why.

dueOn.description: When the review is wanted. Leave out for today.

evidence.description: Links to the material. Each becomes an Evidence Link (O20).

examples.reason: The agent will read supplier prices and act on them.
